newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Feb consumer price index up 9.8 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: S.African Feb consumer price index up 9.8 pct y/y.

text.p: South Africa's all-items consumer price index rose 0.5 percent in February from January after rising 1.3 percent in January, the Central Statistical Service said.
The year-on-year rise was 9.8 percent versus January's 9.4 percent.
A Reuters consensus poll of economists forecast a 0.45 percent month-on-month increase and a 9.75 percent year-on-year rise.

The Central Statistical Service's survey of consumer prices is now broken down into five expenditure groups. The old system of breaking the survey down into three income groups has fallen away and as a result, those indices are no longer applicable. Month-on-month percentage changes in the expenditure groups are thus only be available from February 1997, while year-on-year percentage changes will only be calculated from January 1998.
